formula.name: Siam Barber Citrus
formula.body:
*Bright office-safe aromatic fougere: bergamot rind, lavender-clary foam, dry vetiver moss.*

**Market logic:** Designed for Bangkok daytime wear: fast freshness, low sticky sweetness, clean musks, and a recognizable lavender-coumarin-moss fougere frame.

**Optimizer score:** `-45.025 -> -28.203` (`+16.822`)

### Mixing Order

1. Add musks, woods, moss, coumarin, and low-volatility materials first.
2. Add Hedione/radiance and geranium-floral materials.
3. Add lavender, clary, linalool/linalyl materials.
4. Add citrus, fresh, marine, and trace high-impact materials last.
5. Add ethanol bottle fill after the concentrate is homogeneous.
6. Rest 48 hours before first read; judge seriously after 14 days.

Channel model: 21 materials collapsed into 11 group channels (Laing ceiling applies to channels, not ingredients)
• terpene_alcohol: Linalool, Geraniol, cis-3-Hexenol, Dihydromyrcenol, Ethyl Linalool (5 → 1 channel)
• woody_amber: Iso E Super, Cedarwood oil Virginia, Ambrox Super (3 → 1 channel)

Mid-field: Hedione, Iso E Super, Coumarin, Cedarwood oil Virginia, Hexyl Salicylate

mixing_protocol.full_text:
═══ MIXING PROTOCOL: Siam Barber Citrus ═══
Materials: 25 | Total: 100.0%

─── WARNINGS ───
⚠ CRYSTALLINE SOLIDS: Coumarin — dissolve in warm solvent before adding.

─── PHASE 0: DISSOLUTION ───
  1. Dissolve Coumarin in warm ethanol or DPG (40-50°C) until fully clear before adding to formula.

─── PHASE 1: BASE LAYER (foundation) ───
  Step 2. Add Galaxolide (2.62%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  Step 3. Add Ambrox Super (2.87%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  Step 4. Add Habanolide (6.83%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  Step 5. Add Iso E Super (13.67%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  Step 6. Add Vetiver EO (2.85%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  Step 7. Add Patchouli EO (1.7%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  Step 8. Add Romandolide (3.98%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  → Stir gently for 2-3 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes.

─── PHASE 2: HEART LAYER (character) ───
  Step 9. Add Cedarwood oil Virginia (5.12%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 10. Add Hexyl Salicylate (4.55%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 11. Add Cyclamen Aldehyde (0.48%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 12. Add Clary Sage EO (3.42%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 13. Add Hedione (15.92%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 14. Add Evernyl (1.37%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  → Stir gently for 2-3 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes.

─── PHASE 3: TOP NOTES (sparkle) ───
  Step 15. Add Aldehyde C12 MNA (0.68%)
           Top note — most volatile, add last to preserve freshness.
  Step 16. Add Grapefruit FCF (1.92%)
           Top note — most volatile, add last to preserve freshness.
  Step 17. Add Geraniol (1.65%)

  Step 18. Add Ethyl Linalool (3.42%)

  Step 19. Add Linalyl Acetate (5.7%)

  Step 20. Add Bergamot FCF (5.3%)

  Step 22. Add Linalool (1.45%)

  Step 25. Add cis-3-Hexenol (0.4%)

  Check at day 7 for initial impressions.
  Best results typically at day 23 – 37.
